scope: Read-only finite audit of verifier implementation and completed retained run; no production or commercial correctness approval.
checks: Counts are 112 inherited + 125 document + 14 field-order + 16 associativity = 267. Prior registries and new source/inventory inputs have explicit pins; new declaration names exactly cover their inventories.

Two fresh temporary formal trees are copied from the preserved input snapshot, with the candidate explicitly installed as Allow/Associativity.lean and its import appended. No workspace .lake artifacts are copied. Both builds report 15 identical compiled artifact digests, including Associativity.

Document, field-order and associativity checks require exact pretty-printed registered types. The 112 inherited propositions use kernel-checked examples against the registered statements, preserving proposition inhabitance rather than claiming textual theorem-signature identity. Every theorem receives a strict allowed-axiom audit.

Independently recomputed the canonical manifest root and checked every retained snapshot/generated input against the manifest: no mismatches. Checked all 267 unique claim/evidence/provenance IDs for complete matching coverage, evidence root/verifier binding, all evidence log paths, and every retained audit log digest.

Both builds have identical audit digests and artifact inventories. Provenance is deterministically generated one-to-one from the frozen claims; implementation correspondence is explicitly zero and excluded.
Assertion-based claim/type/axiom/build/determinism/input failures block. Process timeout and unavailable tooling raise infrastructure failures. No override promotes failed checks.
Formal/source inventory mutations are checked at completion. Accepted result remains explicitly limited to the frozen abstract model and trusted Lean/OS/verifier surface.
nonblocking_limitations: The verifier does not itself rehash its copied input snapshot before/after compilation. This audit independently checked all retained copies against the frozen manifest for this completed run. Add snapshot hash checks for future verifier runs to close the avoidable copy-time mutation gap; this approval is not a claim of universal mutation-race resistance.

Compiled artifacts are hashed during each clean build and then temporary directories are removed. Their equality relies on the registered verifier and retained report; this audit checks recorded equality and actual audit logs, not reexecution of builds.
The report records provenance in its companion file rather than explicit report provenance counts. This audit mechanically checked 267 complete matching bindings.
Actual Xss512k runtime, parser/IR correspondence, weighted-subtree bounds, maps/comments/history and latency evidence remain required after any implementation. Model closure does not discharge them.
